results.title: JUMI Jobs Created Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should create at least two Jobs for producer and consumer nodes.

results.title: JUMI Artifacts Registered Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should register at least one producer output through AH.

results.title: JUMI Input Resolve Requests Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should resolve at least one artifact binding before starting the consumer node.

results.title: JUMI Input Remote Fetch Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should observe at least one remote-fetch resolution decision.

results.title: JUMI Input Materializations Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should mark at least one resolved input as requiring materialization.

results.title: JUMI Sample Runs Finalized Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should finalize at least one sample run through AH.

results.title: JUMI GC Evaluate Requests Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should trigger at least one GC evaluation request.

results.title: AH Artifacts Registered Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should register at least one artifact inside AH inventory.

results.title: AH Resolve Requests Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should receive at least one resolve request from JUMI.

results.title: AH Fallback Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should exercise at least one remote-fetch fallback path.

results.title: AH GC Backlog Bytes Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should not leave non-zero AH GC backlog at the end of the window.

results.title: AH Lifecycle Finalized Smoke
results.description: Smoke run should finalize the AH sample-run lifecycle.

results.title: AH Retention Window Active Smoke
results.description: Immediately after finalize+GC evaluate, AH should retain the sample-run under the active retention window.

results.title: AH Retained Artifact Bytes Smoke
results.description: AH lifecycle retainedArtifactBytes should reflect the retained producer outputs for the sample run.

results.title: AH Artifact Metadata Complete Smoke
results.description: AH inventory should retain digest, uri, and sizeBytes for all smoke-run producer artifacts.

results.title: AH Inventory Lifecycle Bytes Match Smoke
results.description: AH lifecycle retainedArtifactBytes should match the sum of retained artifact sizeBytes in inventory.
